title: CmdPal: Bookmark {placeholder} field retains last-entered value on every subsequent open
summary: The issue has deterministic reproduction steps and its stated lifecycle diagnosis matches main. A scoped extension-side reset after a successful launch fixes the stale state without changing Command Palette's general parameter persistence model or the public extension contract.

status.label: Detailed design ready
status.detail: Clear every retained placeholder StringParameterRun only after CommandLauncher.Launch returns true, immediately before returning CommandResult.Dismiss(). Preserve values when Launch returns false and CommandResult.KeepOpen() is returned.

judgment.rationale: The issue has deterministic reproduction steps and its stated lifecycle diagnosis matches main. A scoped extension-side reset after a successful launch fixes the stale state without changing Command Palette's general parameter persistence model or the public extension contract.

evidence.observed: The reported sequence is: a placeholder bookmark opens empty initially, launches with a value, then reopens with the previous value. The issue is open, labeled Issue-Bug and Product-Command Palette, and has no comments.

The constructor starts _classificationGate.ExecuteAsync(); ClassifyAsync constructs one BookmarkPlaceholderPage when Classification.IsPlaceholder; replacement occurs only when Update handles BookmarkUpdated. Reopening the list item does not create another page.

BuildParameterRuns creates and retains StringParameterRun instances in _placeholderRuns. LaunchWithCurrentValues reads their Text values and returns Dismiss on a successful CommandLauncher.Launch, but does not clear those values.
Text is stateful and ClearValue resets it to string.Empty while raising Text and NeedsValue notifications through the existing property path.

The view model initializes TextForUI from the retained StringParameterRun.Text and propagates model Text notifications back to TextForUI. SearchBar's one-way x:Bind Text supplies that value to the TextBox, while TextChanged writes user input to the model. The UI reflects, rather than causes, retention.

judgment.recommended_action: Clear every retained placeholder StringParameterRun only after CommandLauncher.Launch returns true, immediately before returning CommandResult.Dismiss(). Preserve values when Launch returns false and CommandResult.KeepOpen() is returned.

actions.label: Approve design and start fork implementation
actions.note: Review the detailed design, risks, and validation plan before approving implementation.

design.root_cause: BookmarkListItem caches a BookmarkPlaceholderPage for the lifetime of the list item. That page caches one StringParameterRun per unique placeholder. The successful-submit path dismisses the page but leaves those Text values intact; reopening reuses the same page, and StringParameterRunViewModel plus SearchBar.xaml renders the retained text.
evidence: state lifecycle: BookmarkListItem.BookmarkListItem schedules initial classification; BookmarkListItem.ClassifyAsync creates BookmarkPlaceholderPage once for a placeholder bookmark; BookmarkListItem.ApplyClassificationResult stores it in Command.
state lifecycle: BookmarkPlaceholderPage.BuildParameterRuns creates StringParameterRun objects once and stores them in _placeholderRuns, deduplicating repeated placeholder names case-insensitively.
state lifecycle: SearchBar.StringParameter_TextChanged calls StringParameterRunViewModel.SetTextFromUi; the view model serializes the write to IStringParameterRun.Text.
state lifecycle: BookmarkPlaceholderPage.LaunchWithCurrentValues reads _placeholderRuns.Text into BuildEvaluatedBookmark, launches the resolved target, and currently dismisses without resetting.

state lifecycle: On next navigation, StringParameterRunViewModel.InitializeProperties reads the same StringParameterRun.Text into TextForUI; SearchBar.StringParamTemplate renders it using Text="{x:Bind TextForUI, Mode=OneWay}".

retention rule after fix: Retain entered values while the parameters page remains open and whenever a launch fails. Clear all unique placeholder values only after a successful launch, which is also the only path that dismisses the form. A later reopen starts empty and UpdateSubtitle becomes empty through existing Text notifications.

why not ui: Changing SearchBar.xaml to mask or clear TextForUI would leave the extension model, generated target, subtitle, and required-value state stale. The owning BookmarkPlaceholderPage is the correct lifecycle boundary.

affected_files.purpose: Owns placeholder run state and determines successful versus failed bookmark launch behavior.
New focused regression tests for reset-on-success and retention-on-failure.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: LaunchWithCurrentValues builds the target from retained runs, calls CommandLauncher.Launch, then returns CommandResult.Dismiss() if true or CommandResult.KeepOpen() if false. Neither outcome changes _placeholderRuns.
implementation_steps.change: After a true launch result and before returning Dismiss, iterate _placeholderRuns.Values and call ClearValue() on each run. Use ClearValue rather than assigning Text directly so the toolkit's existing property-change and NeedsValue semantics update the preview/view model. Do not clear on false.
edge_cases: Repeated placeholders share one dictionary run, so it is cleared once and every occurrence is empty next time.
Case variants share one run because BuildParameterRuns uses StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.
A failed ShellExecute or activation preserves input and subtitle so the user can correct and retry.
No reset occurs before BuildEvaluatedBookmark or CommandLauncher.Launch; the launched target continues to use the exact entered values.
Clearing invokes OnPlaceholderChanged for Text, which recomputes the command subtitle as empty because AllPlaceholdersHaveValues becomes false.
tests: Add a focused unit test that supplies a successful launch seam, fills two StringParameterRun values, invokes the submit path, asserts CommandResultKind.Dismiss, every run Text == string.Empty, NeedsValue == true, and page.Command.Subtitle == string.Empty.
Add the paired failed-launch test: populate a run, have the seam return false, invoke submit, assert CommandResultKind.KeepOpen and that the run Text and evaluated subtitle remain unchanged.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The static CommandLauncher.Launch call prevents a deterministic unit test of its true and false outcomes without attempting a real shell launch.
implementation_steps.change: Introduce the smallest internal test seam: have the production constructor bind a private Func<Classification, bool> to CommandLauncher.Launch, provide an internal friend-test constructor or optional internal launch delegate parameter, and make only the submit method callable by the existing InternalsVisibleTo test assembly if necessary. Keep the public extension contract unchanged. Tests pass delegates returning true or false; production continues to call CommandLauncher.Launch.
edge_cases: Do not add a setting or persistent preference; the issue's expected behavior is an empty form per invocation.
Keep the seam internal and scoped to this internal page class; the existing Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs already grants InternalsVisibleTo("Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.Bookmarks.UnitTests").
Avoid making CommandLauncher virtual or changing its shell-launch implementation.
tests: Construct BookmarkPlaceholderPage with a real BookmarkResolver and PlaceholderParser plus a deterministic launch delegate, avoiding shell/UI automation.
Use a URL such as https://example.com/issue/ABC-{n}-{suffix} to validate multiple unique runs; optionally use {n}/{N} to prove deduplicated case-insensitive reset.

verify: targeted tests: Build the focused project with <PowerToysCheckout>\tools\build\build.cmd -Path "<PowerToysCheckout>\src\modules\cmdpal\Tests\Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.Bookmarks.UnitTests" -Configuration Debug -Platform x64.
targeted tests: Run the complete bookmark unit-test assembly: vstest.console.exe x64\Debug\WinUI3Apps\CmdPal\tests\Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.Bookmarks.UnitTests.dll.
manual repro: Create bookmark URL https://example.com/issue/ABC-{n}; open it, enter 1, and submit successfully.
manual repro: Reopen the same bookmark and confirm n is blank; enter 2 and confirm the launched target uses ABC-2, not the prior value.
manual repro: Force or simulate a failed launch and confirm the form remains open with its entered value retained.
non regression: Bookmark edits still recreate the command through BookmarkListItem.Update and _classificationGate.
non regression: Non-placeholder bookmark commands and all global StringParameterRun consumers retain their existing behavior.

risks.risk: Clearing before the launch result is known would lose retry input after failure.
risks.mitigation: Clear only in the success branch after CommandLauncher.Launch returns true.

risks.risk: Testing with CommandLauncher directly could start external processes or make tests environment-dependent.
risks.mitigation: Use a narrow internal launch delegate seam in the existing friend-test assembly.

risks.risk: A UI-level change could desynchronize TextBox content from the extension model.
risks.mitigation: Reset the owning StringParameterRun state and rely on existing notifications/bindings.

alternatives.option: Recreate BookmarkPlaceholderPage each time the list item is opened.
alternatives.reason: No explicit open lifecycle hook is evident in BookmarkListItem, and reconstruction would unnecessarily repeat classification/icon setup and alter broader command-instance behavior.

alternatives.option: Clear parameters on every navigation to a ParametersPage.
alternatives.reason: That would change generic Command Palette parameter semantics and would also discard values after failed submissions or navigation.

alternatives.option: Make SearchBar.xaml bind two-way or clear the TextBox on load.
alternatives.reason: The model remains stale, and two-way binding is unrelated to the retained page state.
